script.cover_1: You finish the slides. The brief changes. Again. Is that normal?
script.payoff: It often happens when the ask was never written down, and a short brief prevents rework.
script.caption: Rework usually starts with a spoken brief. Send this to the colleague who redraws the same slide all week.
script.situation: Can they keep changing the brief after you finish?
script.answer: It often happens when the ask was never written down. A short written brief up front often prevents rework.
script.reply_me: To avoid rework, can we write the brief in short points before I start the next version?
